ruleImpact.log-writes-personal-data: A field named as personal data is written to a log, exposing it to everyone who can read the log

ruleRemedy.job-loads-from-an-authorised-library: Restrict write access to the authorised library to the change process that owns it, and load from an unauthorised copy where the job does not need authority
ruleRemedy.log-writes-a-credential: Do not log credential-shaped fields; mask or omit them before DISPLAY or any journal/log write
ruleRemedy.log-writes-personal-data: Do not log personal-data fields; mask, tokenize or omit them before the log write
ruleRemedy.display-echoes-a-credential: Acknowledge the credential without repeating it, or mask it before it is displayed
ruleRemedy.binary-store-exceeds-picture-under-trunc: Make the receiver COMP-5 or wide enough for the value, add ON SIZE ERROR, or compile the program with TRUNC(STD) or TRUNC(BIN)
ruleRemedy.intermediate-result-loses-high-order-dig: Split the expression so each step fits, carry fewer decimal places in the operands and receivers, or compile with ARITH(EXTEND) where one more digit is enough
ruleRemedy.character-range-reverses-in-ascii: Test the class the range means (IS NUMERIC, IS ALPHABETIC, a CLASS condition) or list the values, rather than relying on the order of the code page
ruleRemedy.zowe-config-secret-in-clear: Remove the value from properties and list the key in the profile's secure array, so Zowe keeps it in the operating system's credential vault
ruleRemedy.zowe-config-tls-verify-off: Set rejectUnauthorized to true and install the certificate authority that signed the mainframe's certificate
ruleRemedy.zowe-mcp-password-in-config: Replace the literal with a reference such as ${env:NAME} and keep the value in the environment or a secrets manager
ruleRemedy.zowe-mcp-tier-writes: Run at read-strict or read unless write access is reviewed and needed; grant update or delete for the task that needs it
ruleRemedy.zowe-mcp-tier-full: Run at read-strict or read; give job submission to a separate, reviewed path
ruleRemedy.zowe-mcp-data-marking-off: Remove ZOWE_MCP_DATA_MARKING=0 so the default marking applies

evidence.path: untrusted input was traced to a sensitive operation, and the route it took is recorded
evidence.construct: the construct is a defect wherever it appears; no input has to reach it
evidence.tampering: the source is arranged so a reader or a resolver sees something other than what runs
evidence.advisory: a component version matches a published advisory against it
evidence.exposure: information about the estate is written into the source
evidence.change: a change moves an interface or adds a call target, which a reviewer has to look at
evidence.coverage: the analysis stopped following here; a limit of the tool, not a defect in the code
evidence.context: describes the estate - an entry point, a product in use - and asserts no defect

exploitabilityVerdicts.confirmed: the estate reproduced it on a system it owns and brought the result as a witness feed
exploitabilityVerdicts.exploitable: input an attacker supplies reaches the operation with no check on every route, and the estate declares an entry that carries it open to any user
exploitabilityVerdicts.attacker-driven: input whoever runs an entry supplies reaches the operation with no check on every route; the estate has not declared who may run that entry
exploitabilityVerdicts.restricted: input reaches the operation with no check on every route, and every entry that carries it is behind a control the estate named
exploitabilityVerdicts.mitigated: input reaches the operation, but a check runs first on every route, or SSRANGE turns an overrun into an abend
exploitabilityVerdicts.upstream: the value comes from a file record or a database row, so whoever can write that data drives it
exploitabilityVerdicts.refuted: no harmful value arrives: a check leaves only values the operation can take, or no route reaches it
